Name: Tiny Apartments (PIF)
Author: Sharogg
Description:
Just another PIF mod of some rooms I drafted for fun a while ago.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/59674311-1773528136.png[/img]

[list]
[*]5 sets of apartments with 2-4 rooms each
[*]fully decoratable
[*]you can place beds and fridges to use and decorate as you please
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/59674311-1773528224.png[/img]

[b]Recolours[/b]: Compatible with the same recolours that my tilesheet mod is compatible with (VPR and Earthy explicitly, but you can use another recolour and pick the one that looks best without any hard clashes)


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/59674311-1773528309.png[/img]

[b]Furniture mods used for decorating:[/b]
HxW furniture packs: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27174]Plants[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27124]Plant Lovers[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9989]Fairy Garden[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31807]Kitchen Lovers[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26330]Ripley's kitchen[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33316]Kisaa's buildable kitchen[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28537]Door Mania[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27047]PCs Rattan Furniture[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30602]Guxelbit's walls and floors[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19186]Vanilla Furniture Tweaks[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26505]Lumisteria's furniture[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9753]Lumisteria walls and floors[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27122]Molamoles Wallpapers and flooring[/url]


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/59674311-1773528397.png[/img]

Unzip the mod and paste it into Stardew Valley's Mods folder. Make sure you have all the dependencies installed. 1.6. is required.
You need to buy one of the doors from PIF or a decorational door to access it. Check out the instructions on the PIF modpage if you don't know how it works.
